resolvedManual.title: r.step.webhook.send drops the unused retry option
resolvedManual.reason: No r.step.webhook.send call in src, bin or seeds (grep webhook.send: no hits).

resolvedManual.title: Delivery errors are fixed codes instead of raw messages
resolvedManual.reason: No custom delivery channel; channel delivery is bundled (grep NotifyDelivery|DeliveryErrorCode: no hits).

resolvedManual.title: App error reasons only carry a docsUrl when errorDocs covers them
resolvedManual.reason: No KumikoError.docsUrl reads and no client reading docsUrl (grep docsUrl|errorDocs: no hits).

resolvedManual.title: Key Manager slots are required, LEGACY_SLOTS default removed
resolvedManual.reason: bin/kumiko.ts passes kmsSlots: [] to runSchemaCli (no Key Manager ciphertexts); bin/main.ts uses the sync resolveKmsWiring, not the async variants.

resolvedManual.title: kumiko check requires uiRoots for kind "app"
resolvedManual.reason: kumiko.json declares uiRoots for kind "app" (src/app, src/public, src/marketing, src/features/*/web).

resolvedManual.title: Telegram apiBaseUrl must match allowedHosts and use https
resolvedManual.reason: Telegram channel not mounted, no apiBaseUrl (grep telegram|apiBaseUrl: no hits).

resolvedManual.title: ctx.secrets.set validates against the declared valueSchema
resolvedManual.reason: No programmatic ctx.secrets.set and no createSecretsContext call (grep: no hits).

resolvedManual.title: Invitations can carry a global role (SystemAdmin), granted only on accept
resolvedManual.reason: read_tenant_invitations.global_roles added by kumiko/migrations/0028_framework-0-343-bump.sql; schema validate reports no drift.

resolvedManual.title: Chat channels deliver in production boot, ctx.notify returns a NotifyResult
resolvedManual.reason: No NotifyFn mocks and no ctx.notify result reads (grep NotifyFn|ctx.notify: no hits).

resolvedManual.title: MFA required policy is writable by the system only
resolvedManual.reason: show-pony never writes auth-mfa:config:required (grep auth-mfa:config: no hits).

resolvedManual.title: Repo-local direct-fs exceptions with a frozen reason, bundled read-only assets
resolvedManual.reason: .kumiko-direct-fs-baseline.json carries the frozen reason for src/marketing/render-landing.ts writing the marketing pages into dist/.

resolvedManual.title: Deploy migrate-step.sh always uses the exact stack network
resolvedManual.reason: package.json sets no kumiko.deploy.stackNetwork; deploy/migrate-step.sh regenerated with kumiko-init-deploy (exact <project>_stack network via COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME or dir name).

resolvedManual.title: workflow-run stream stores a reference to the trigger event instead of its payload
resolvedManual.reason: Workflow engine not mounted (no workflow_run tables in kumiko/migrations), no triggerPayload reads.

resolvedManual.title: fetchForWriting handles reject appends after a concurrent write
resolvedManual.reason: No test fires concurrent writes on one aggregate; no fetchForWriting reject handling in app code.

resolvedManual.title: ctx.db.unsafeRaw() takes no reason; the audit uses the declared escapeHatch reason
resolvedManual.reason: No ctx.db.unsafeRaw call in src, bin or seeds (grep unsafeRaw: no hits).

resolvedManual.title: ownership.write applies to assign-tag, remove-tag and add-note
resolvedManual.reason: No ownership.write on any mount (grep ownership: only a comment in event-handlers.ts).

resolvedManual.title: caps:usage and my-caps default to admin roles; widen with usageVisibleTo
resolvedManual.reason: No usageVisibleTo and no cap-overview/my-caps mount (grep usageVisibleTo|my-caps: no hits).

resolvedManual.title: SubscriptionProviderPlugin.cancelSubscription takes { providerSubscriptionId, when }
resolvedManual.reason: The custom SubscriptionProviderPlugins (bin/e2e-billing-stub.ts, billing-plans test mock) implement no cancelSubscription.

resolvedManual.title: Remove rawPayload from provider events and event headers
resolvedManual.reason: Removed the stale rawPayload field from the process-event payload in bin/e2e-billing-stub.ts; no other rawPayload reads (grep rawPayload: no hits).

resolvedManual.title: searchable text fields must not declare a restricted access.read
resolvedManual.reason: The only find:fuzzy field (rsvp name, schema/rsvp.ts) declares no restricted access.read.

resolvedManual.title: signature routes with a :param segment or wildcard must not match framework paths
resolvedManual.reason: The only signature route is /webhooks/subscription/:providerName, which has a static prefix.

resolvedManual.title: manifest patterns reject symlinks escaping the repo root behind wildcard segments
resolvedManual.reason: kumiko.json patterns (src, bin, seeds) contain no symlinks leaving the repo.

resolvedManual.title: secrets:set and secrets:delete accept only keys declared via r.secret; r.secret takes writeRoles
resolvedManual.reason: No secrets:set/secrets:delete calls and no undeclared secret keys (grep secrets:set|r.secret: no hits).

resolvedManual.title: Anonymous callers on protected handlers get 401 unauthenticated, and a stale auth cookie no longer blocks public handlers
resolvedManual.reason: becf43a switched rsvp-anonymous.integration.test.ts to expect 401 for anonymous callers on protected handlers.

resolvedManual.title: buildServer refuses partially wired session callbacks
resolvedManual.reason: show-pony boots through runProdApp/runDevApp and never calls buildServer directly.

resolvedManual.title: DataTableRowGrouping.headerLabel may return undefined
resolvedManual.reason: No custom DataTable primitive with rowGrouping (grep rowGrouping: no hits).

resolvedManual.title: /api/sse sends change signals without field values; anonymous connections only for declared entities
resolvedManual.reason: No SSE frame payload reads and no own createSseRoute; runProdApp wires the route.

resolvedManual.title: LiveEvent data has no payload, it carries eventType
resolvedManual.reason: No LiveEvent data.payload reads (grep LiveEvent|data.payload: no hits).

resolvedManual.title: Manifest rejects unknown denyQns, drops navs under hidden parents; doc lint flags blank and exposed-undescribed handlers
resolvedManual.reason: No denyQns or buildAgentManifest (grep: no hits).

resolvedManual.title: config:write:set masks the echoed value for encrypted-at-rest keys; validation errors no longer include the value
resolvedManual.reason: No caller reads data.value from config:write:set for encrypted or secrets-backed keys.

resolvedManual.title: createSecretsFeature rejects access and roles together
resolvedManual.reason: createSecretsFeature() is called without access or roles (run-config.ts, billing tests).

resolvedManual.title: Mollie one-off prices no longer need an interval; a subscription price without one is rejected

resolvedManual.title: Provider name "unknown" is reserved for upcast legacy events

resolvedManual.title: Cap helpers validate periodStartIso and amount, surface failed soft-warn writes; German column labels
resolvedManual.reason: show-pony never calls bookCapUsage or markCapSoftWarned directly.

resolvedManual.title: TemplateResource and text-block/collection query outputs expose modifiedAt instead of updatedAt
resolvedManual.reason: src/legal-terms.ts no longer reads the never-populated updatedAt from template-resolver by-slug; the terms etag hashes slug, locale, title and content.

resolvedManual.title: Channel plugin guard validates mode and render
resolvedManual.reason: No custom delivery channel plugin; channel-email is bundled.

resolvedManual.title: Unregistered catalog.providerName fails unconfigured; switch-plan checks provider mismatch before lookup
resolvedManual.reason: No catalog.providerName set on billing-foundation (billing/plan-catalog.ts).

resolvedManual.title: Job runner keeps retry budget on sequential lock conflicts, names the error without a db, fails loudly on bad tenantVisibleFailure subjects, stamps the raw feature name; jobs list filters multi-status
resolvedManual.reason: No custom Registry, no jobs:query:list call, no audit filter on metadata.feature.

resolvedManual.title: Boot rejects multiple principalStatus providers, updateMany rejects unknown columns again
resolvedManual.reason: No updateMany call and no principalStatus provider in src, bin or seeds (grep: no hits).

resolvedManual.title: AgentReasons.permissionDenied removed
resolvedManual.reason: No AgentReasons.permissionDenied reference (grep: no hits).

resolvedManual.title: FileRef type drops the unreachable isDeleted field

resolvedManual.title: File content check covers csv alias, local list scoped to prefix, provider contract checked, locale tags canonicalized
resolvedManual.reason: No file provider mounted (grep file provider wiring in run-config.ts/bin: no hits).

resolvedManual.title: Global-table tenant writes reject loudly, restore maps unique violations, managed unique-index changes recreate
resolvedManual.reason: No tenant-mode updateMany/deleteMany in src, bin or seeds (grep: no hits).

resolvedManual.reason: No multiSelect filters or projectionDetail writeForm sections in show-pony code.

resolvedManual.reason: No totalsMatch fields in show-pony entities.

resolvedManual.title: InfinityList live defaults to false
resolvedManual.reason: No InfinityList usage (grep: no hits).

resolvedManual.reason: No wizard steps, entityEdit or projectionDetail delete actions in show-pony code.

resolvedManual.reason: No r.step.read.findOne/findMany calls (grep r.step.read: no hits).

resolvedManual.reason: No ctx.queryAs/ctx.writeAs calls (grep queryAs|writeAs: no hits).

resolvedManual.title: ctx.queryAs/ctx.writeAs with a SYSTEM identity only from r.systemScope(), jobs, or a handler/hook declaring escapeHatch (fw#2859).
